roleTitle: Lead Software Engineer, Warehouse Control System
jobDescription: An e-commerce fulfilment company runs its own warehouse control system, which routes totes across the conveyor network in each fulfilment centre. The lead software engineer leads a small team, sets the service architecture, approves production releases, integrates with the conveyor PLCs in C# and supports site cutovers. Some conveyor sections are safety-rated, and the company would value experience of leading the certification of a safety-rated control system. The software team reports to the head of automation engineering, and each site has an engineering manager who owns the cutover plan for that site.
requirements: Leads a software team, setting the architecture and approving production releases.
Integrates warehouse software with PLCs and conveyor controls.
Supports software cutovers at warehouse sites.
Writes and reviews C# and .NET code.
Has led the certification of a safety-rated control system.

evidence.text: Lead software engineer at Mercer Fulfilment from November 2020 to August 2024, leading four engineers on the warehouse control system that routes totes across the conveyor network.
Set the service architecture for the tote-routing engine and approved production releases as the release authority named in the team's release procedure.
Built the PLC message interface in C# that exchanges routing decisions with the conveyor controllers over the site network, with message acknowledgements and a retry queue.

Was on site for the cutover of the new routing engine at two fulfilment centres in 2023, running the fallback checks with each site's engineering manager and staying for the first full shift on the new engine.

Reviewed the team's pull requests and ran a fortnightly design review with the four engineers; contributed test evidence to the conveyor supplier's safety assessment, which the supplier's safety engineer led.

Work sample: the team's release procedure, which lists the candidate under 'Release authority', and the approved release record for routing engine version 3.2 with the candidate's approval and the test summary.
HR verification note: employment at Mercer Fulfilment and the title Lead Software Engineer were confirmed in writing by the employer's HR team, together with the employment dates.
Recruiter logistics note: candidate can travel to the northern sites one week a month and is free for a technical interview after 20 October, and would like to see the site where the role is based.

propositions.text: The candidate led four engineers on the warehouse control system and, as the named release authority, approved production releases of the tote-routing engine.
propositions.rationale: The resume states the team and the authority, and the release procedure and release record show it.

propositions.text: The candidate built the PLC message interface in C# that exchanges routing decisions with the conveyor controllers.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the interface directly.

propositions.text: The candidate was on site for the routing-engine cutover at two fulfilment centres in 2023, running the fallback checks with site engineering.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the cutover support.

gold.expectedGap: The candidate contributed test evidence to the supplier's safety assessment, which the supplier's safety engineer led; leading a certification is not documented.
gold.expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the documented team leadership and release authority; describe the safety work as contributed test evidence to an assessment the supplier led.
